description: Haltestellen mit Linienreferenz is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. Die Haltestellen-Dateien, die du in diesem Datensatz herunterladen kannst, geben Auskunft über alle Haltestellen, die von unseren rnv-Linien angefahren werden.Erläuterung zum Aufbau:Eine station, mit Attribut name und id, hat mehrere poles. Diese sind georeferenziert (lat und lon) und haben ebenfalls eine id. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. Its tags are opendata-öpnv. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/XML. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
